note: Redline 075 Perf A/B (2026-10-29): the old-built town (Assets/Scenes/OldTown.unity, OldTownSwap at cc903ae0) against our district (Assets/Scenes/HarbourDistrict.unity), warm, uncapped, 1920x1080 windowed, against brief 064 A5 (warm mean <= 13.0 ms, p99 <= 16.7 ms). SPEC, NOT RUN: an Air run needs Sky's OK (Aster asks). Two development players from ONE commit, both built by PerfBuild (briefs/075/notes.md, 'Perf A/B', item B). Stops are given in PLAN coordinates (x, level, y); PerfBuild resolves them per scene: HarbourDistrict focus = (x, level, y); OldTown focus = (x, level, y + 206) (OldTownSwap.DZ: plan (x, y) = old Unity (x, z - 206)). The four switches marked PENDING (pipeline, oldCrowd, msaa, oldLens, fogPass) do not exist in PerfVariant yet: JsonUtility drops unknown keys, so until Latch adds them and the player echoes them, every variant below runs as `as-built` against itself. run-air-075ab.sh refuses a result that does not echo them. Verdict: the as-built warm mean and p99 per stop per scene against 13.0 / 16.7; the old town's cuts (variants) give each cut's measured saving for the ranked list in briefs/075/oldbuild/perf.md.
content: world as built, people layer stripped (PerfStrip, both players). OldTown keeps its baked glTF crowd (District / Southside crowd and traffic roots, 2,590 static instances): it is world, not the people layer, and is switched by oldCrowd.

variants.name: as-built
variants.why: each scene as Sky saw it: OldTown with the old pipeline (PC_RPAsset of OldTownArt: MSAA 4, depth + opaque texture, GRD off, old renderer with Harbour fog and depth-normals SSAO), its lens (Gaussian DOF, sun flare with occlusion, bloom 0.8/0.6) and its crowd; HarbourDistrict as shipped

variants.name: old-no-crowd
variants.why: OldTown only: the glTF crowd and cars hidden (renderers off under 'District crowd and traffic' and 'Southside crowd and traffic'). as-built - this = cut 1

variants.name: old-no-msaa

variants.name: old-lean-lens
variants.why: OldTown only: crowd off, MSAA 1, DOF and the flare off at play, depth and opaque textures by request. old-no-msaa - this = cut 3
